title: Spec Kit: 28 reported defects
status: Reported findings and their upstream outcomes as of 2026-11-10. This website did not rerun the reproductions
disclosure: Found and reproduced with Claude Code, run autonomously under human supervision. The human reporter re-ran every reproduction above before filing.

triageLabels.triage-must-have: Verdict: high-value, important work for Spec Kit — do first
triageLabels.triage-can-wait: Verdict: valid and in-scope but deprioritized; held behind the evidence gate
triageLabels.triage-nice-to-have: Verdict: evidence-backed fix or greenlit feature — land after review

issues.title: Chained comparisons such as `0 <= x <= 10` in workflow expressions silently return the wrong result
issues.contradicts: The module docstring calls the evaluator “a safe Jinja2 subset”, and Jinja2 and Python both chain comparisons.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): evaluate chained comparisons pairwise like Python

issues.title: `==` and `!=` do not compare numeric strings as numbers, while `<`, `>`, `<=` and `>=` do
issues.contradicts: The _safe_compare docstring and a test in tests/test_workflows.py say numeric strings compare as numbers.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): coerce numeric strings for == and != like ordering ope

issues.title: Unsupported expression syntax evaluates to None silently instead of raising
issues.contradicts: The module docstring calls the evaluator “a safe Jinja2 subset” and lists string and numeric literals as supported.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): evaluate exponent numbers and chained indexing, reject

issues.title: `catalog add` gives the new catalog the same priority as the first existing catalog when priorities are implicit
issues.contradicts: A code comment says the new priority is the highest existing priority plus one.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): append catalog sources after implicit priorities

issues.title: `workflow update` rejects an archive catalog release when its version has leading zeros (for example CalVer `2024.02.01`)
issues.contradicts: The workflow version format accepts 2024.02.01, and the same catalog entry installs when its URL is a .yml file.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): accept equivalent version spellings in archive updates

issues.title: Workflow commands crash with `rich.errors.MarkupError` when user or catalog text contains square brackets
issues.contradicts: command_info.py treats every workflow.yml field as untrusted, and workflow search already escapes the same text.

fixes.title: fix(5076): escape Rich markup in workflow output

issues.title: `workflow add <url>` installs workflow.yml with mode 0600, while a catalog install uses the project file mode
issues.contradicts: A test asserts mode 0644 for a catalog install, and the _stage_workflow_file docstring describes the normal project mode.

fixes.title: fix(workflows): give URL-installed workflow.yml project file mode

issues.title: `integration switch` leaves the manifest out of date when a preset overrides a core command
issues.contradicts: The _resync_manifest_after_registration docstring says the manifest is re-hashed after preset registration.

fixes.title: fix(integrations): refresh manifest hashes after preset registration o
fix(integrations): refresh manifest hashes after init --force and swit
fix(integrations): refresh the fallback's manifest hashes on uninstall

issues.title: Removing Vibe event hooks deletes user comments that follow a Spec Kit hook block
issues.contradicts: The _without_managed_hooks docstring says it preserves every other source slice verbatim.

fixes.title: fix(vibe): keep user comments that follow a managed hook block

issues.title: A hook with a list-valued `command` passes manifest validation, then crashes `extension add` and leaves files behind
issues.contradicts: EXTENSION-API-REFERENCE.md documents command as a string, and the manifest promises a ValidationError for a bad manifest.

fixes.title: fix(extensions): reject hook commands that are not strings

issues.title: Extension alias conflict check misses spellings that map to the same file, so one extension overwrites and then deletes another's alias
issues.contradicts: The _validate_install_conflicts docstring says installs that would shadow installed extension commands are rejected.

fixes.title: fix(extensions): reject aliases that resolve to installed skill names

issues.title: `specify extension update` crashes with KeyError when a catalog entry has no `version`, and stops checking the other extensions
issues.contradicts: The same function skips an invalid catalog version with a warning, and catalog loading tolerates one malformed entry.

fixes.title: fix(extensions): skip catalog entries without a version on update

issues.title: Local config override file name differs between the docs (`<id>-config.local.yml`) and ConfigManager (`local-config.yml`)
issues.contradicts: EXTENSION-USER-GUIDE.md names the override file <id>-config.local.yml.

fixes.title: docs(extensions): name the runtime local override file

issues.title: Top-level `defaults:` in extension.yml, as documented and used in the extension template, is ignored by ConfigManager
issues.contradicts: EXTENSION-API-REFERENCE.md and the extension template put defaults under a top-level defaults key.

fixes.title: fix(extensions): load top-level defaults from extension.yml

issues.title: `preset add` crashes with AttributeError when a composing command's frontmatter is not a YAML mapping
issues.contradicts: CommandRegistrar.parse_frontmatter treats the same non-mapping frontmatter as empty.

fixes.title: fix(presets): treat non-mapping command frontmatter as empty

issues.title: `resolve_with_source` reports a core template whose name starts with "overrides" as a project override
issues.contradicts: collect_all_layers reports the same file as a core template.

fixes.title: fix(presets): attribute core templates with overrides-prefixed names c

issues.title: `specify preset set-priority` does not update agent command files that are already written
issues.contradicts: docs/reference/presets.md says the preset with the lowest priority number wins.

fixes.title: fix(presets): reconcile command files after priority changes

issues.title: `bundle build` reports success but omits a symlinked `bundle.yml`/`README.md`, producing an artifact that cannot be installed
issues.contradicts: The build validates bundle.yml and README.md, then leaves them out of the artifact it reports as built.

fixes.title: fix(bundles): refuse to build when bundle.yml or README.md is a symlin

issues.title: `bundle init <bundle>` initialises with the default integration instead of the bundle's, then aborts with a clash
issues.contradicts: bundle install initialises with the bundle’s declared integration.

fixes.title: fix(bundles): honor bundle integration during init

issues.title: `bundle install` rejects a local artifact with an upper-case `.ZIP` extension
issues.contradicts: docs/reference/bundles.md accepts a local .zip artifact, and the download path compares the extension case-insensitively.

fixes.title: Fix local bundle installation for uppercase .ZIP artifacts

issues.title: `integration:` mapping without an `id` makes a bundle silently integration-agnostic
issues.contradicts: A comment in manifest.py guards against a declared integration being dropped silently.

fixes.title: fix(bundles): reject integration mappings without an id

issues.title: integration-events.yml entry without an `events` key silently removes all event hooks
issues.contradicts: A code comment says only an explicitly present events field replaces the prior layers.

fixes.title: fix: retain event hooks when override omits events

issues.title: Malformed `events` in an unregistered extension directory makes `specify integration upgrade` fail
issues.contradicts: validate_events rejects the same matcher and timeout values.

fixes.title: fix: validate collected extension events

issues.title: `specify extension add --dev` shows a traceback when `.extensionignore` is a directory
issues.contradicts: The _install_ignore.py docstring says an invalid ignore file raises a validation error before copying.

fixes.title: fix: report a non-file .extensionignore or .presetignore as a validati

issues.title: `specify self upgrade` reports "unsupported" for uv tool installs under XDG_DATA_HOME (and likely for current pipx installs)
issues.contradicts: docs/upgrade.md says self upgrade detects uv tool and pipx installs.

fixes.title: fix: detect relocated uv and pipx tool installations

issues.title: `create-new-feature.sh` rejects the feature descriptions `-n`, `-e` and `-E`, which the Python script accepts
issues.contradicts: The Python version of the script accepts the same descriptions, and a comment in the bash script says it uses printf for this reason.

fixes.title: fix(git): preserve option-like branch descriptions
fix(scripts): treat option-like feature descriptions as text in create
fix: use printf instead of echo for feature description to avoid -n/-e

issues.title: Cline extension and preset commands have `speckit.*.md` file names rewritten to `speckit-*-md`
issues.contradicts: Inferred from the file naming in extensions/git; no document states it.

fixes.title: fix(cline): keep .md extension on speckit.* file names in command bodi

issues.title: Re-running `specify init --here --force` resets `feature_numbering` in init-options.json to "sequential"
issues.contradicts: Inferred from the option merge in command_init.py and the documentation of the setting; no document states it.

fixes.title: fix: preserve feature numbering during reinitialization

automatedInvalidNote: Spec Kit’s automated bug-assessment workflow added the invalid label to #5078, #5079 and #5080 on 2026-10-29, after fixes for all three had merged on 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28. Its comment on #5078 says the label means “not currently reproducible/actionable on current codebase”, not “that the original report lacked merit”. Its comment on #5079 says it could not run the reproduction and read the code and tests instead.

expressions.contract: The module docstring at the filing commit describes the evaluator as “a safe Jinja2 subset”.

witnesses.note: Read as 0 <= (inputs.n <= 10). An if step with this condition ran its then branch, and validate_workflow reported no errors.
The same split, the other way round.
The same value was both >= 10 and <= 10. Jinja2 agrees with == here; the report is about the inconsistency inside Spec Kit.
The literal was looked up as a variable.
An escaped quote was not recognised as part of the string.
Only one index was accepted per path segment.
Word operators were found only with a space on both sides.

upstream.change: #5114 split the evaluator into a package. #5130 added tests that pin its existing behaviour, citing #5071 and #5073.
#5171 replaced the hand-written parser with a Lark grammar. The documentation now says all comparisons share one level and group left to right, so a == b > 0 means (a == b) > 0.

On #5072 a maintainer first wrote that Python semantics, with no coercion of numeric strings, were the intended contract. #5310 then made == and != coerce numeric strings, as the ordering operators do, and the maintainer closed the issue.
#5203, which would evaluate chained comparisons pairwise, is open. #5206, aimed at #5073, was closed without merging.

reading.reading: Groups as (0 <= 50) <= 10, which is True <= 10. The coercion helper treats True as a number, so the result still looks true. The documentation now describes left-to-right grouping.
Now coerces both sides, so it looks true. That matches Spec Kit’s ordering operators and differs from Jinja2 and Python.
No longer match the grammar’s number, string or path terminals, so they look like syntax errors instead of None.
The operator terminals accept a quote before the word, so these look correctly evaluated.
The coercion helper still reads "1e3" as text, so the comparison looks silently false.

expressions.readingNote: An AI agent read the grammar and operators on main at 1ed587a0 while preparing this page. It did not run them. A reading is not evidence, so every row here is Not yet reached until a reproduction runs on main.

notYetReached.behavior: A differential test of the expression evaluator against Jinja2
notYetReached.blocker: Spec Kit now documents deliberate departures from Jinja2, such as left-to-right comparison grouping and numeric-string equality, so Jinja2 alone is no longer a correct reference.
notYetReached.question: Which Jinja2 behaviours does Spec Kit intend to keep, and can they be written down as a reference model to test against?

notYetReached.behavior: Whether the defects matter to users
notYetReached.blocker: The study has no data on how often the affected commands and inputs are used.
notYetReached.question: How should a finding’s severity be estimated when the project publishes no usage data?

contribution.human: Harry re-ran every reproduction before filing, and filed the 28 reports under his own account. Each report records the same output on a Linux container and on macOS.
contribution.checks: Each reproduction is a script with recorded output at the filing commit. The maintainers’ triage and the merged fixes are their own decisions and are reported here, not counted as Crosscheck’s evidence.
